theme_strategy.description: A sophisticated dark charcoal theme paired with warm off-white typography and a tasteful burnt terracotta accent. This creates a premium, authoritative, yet highly creative studio aesthetic. No pure blacks or pure whites.

visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid generic SaaS gradients. Use localized, very subtle radial glows (e.g., bg-white/5 blur-3xl) behind key elements like the kinetic hero or mockups to create depth.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(244, 244, 241, 0.08). Expose the grid skeleton in the services and process sections using border-collapse techniques.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Crystal Glass' strictly for the sticky header (bg-[#0D0D0F]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10). Use flat solids for everything else.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle SVG noise overlay fixed to the viewport with opacity-20 and pointer-events-none to give the site an editorial, printed feel.

motion.kinetic_hero: Staggered line-by-line text reveal. Wrap each line of text in an 'overflow-hidden' container. Animate the inner text from y:'100%' to y:'0%' with a duration of 1s and an easing of [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1].
motion.scroll_reveals: Use Framer Motion 'whileInView'. Elements should fade in (opacity: 0 -> 1) and slide up slightly (y: 30 -> 0) as they enter the viewport. Viewport margin: '-100px'.
motion.smooth_scroll: Implement Lenis for buttery smooth scrolling. This is MANDATORY for the premium feel.
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons should have a slight scale down on tap (scale: 0.98). Portfolio mockups should have a slow, subtle zoom (scale 1.05) on the inner image on hover while the container remains fixed.

components.button: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary CTA: bg-[#D45B3E] text-[#F4F4F1] px-8 py-4 font-medium transition-all hover:bg-[#B84A30] hover:scale-[1.02].
components.browser_mockup: A container representing a sleek browser window. Classes: `rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-[#16161A] overflow-hidden`. The top header should be `h-10 border-b border-white/10 bg-[#1A1A1E] flex items-center px-4 gap-2`. Add three small circles (`w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-white/20`) to mimic macOS buttons.
components.services_card: Minimalist bento-style card. `border border-white/10 p-8 relative overflow-hidden group`. Include a massive, faint number (e.g., '01') in the background using `text-8xl text-white/5 absolute -bottom-4 -right-4 font-heading`.
components.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Very slow speed. Text should be the Cormorant Garamond italic (e.g., 'Digital Experiences • Brand Identity • Creative Direction •'). Low contrast (text-[#8B8B93]).

layouts_and_grids.hero: Asymmetrical layout. Massive text block on the left taking up 8 columns, right side empty or containing a small spinning badge/accolade.
layouts_and_grids.portfolio: Alternating bento grid. One row is a full-width featured project (col-span-12), the next row splits two projects (col-span-6 each).
layouts_and_grids.spacing: Exaggerated spacing. Use py-32 or py-40 between major sections to give the content immense breathing room.

pages_blueprint.Home: Sticky Header -> Kinetic Text Hero ('Websites That Make Businesses Stand Out') -> Editorial Marquee -> Featured Work (Browser Mockups) -> Micro-Services snippet -> Footer.
pages_blueprint.Work: Header -> Intro -> Massive Grid of case studies (Alpaca, Stripes, etc.) -> 'Design Concepts' section (labeled clearly) using a tighter grid -> Footer.
pages_blueprint.Services: Header -> Deep dive numbered cards (01 Web Design, 02 E-Commerce, etc.) -> Process visual timeline (vertical line with branching steps) -> CTA.
pages_blueprint.Process: Header -> Step-by-step breakdown (Discovery, Design, Build, Launch). Use large numbers, sticky scrolling where left side is sticky step name and right side scrolls details.
pages_blueprint.About: Header -> Manifesto (large editorial text paragraph mixing Cabinet and Garamond) -> Profile image + Bio -> Philosophy -> CTA.
pages_blueprint.Contact: Header -> Split layout: Left side contact info & vibe, Right side cleanly designed Shadcn-customized form (Name, Business, Needs, Budget, Details) with dark minimalist inputs.

media.image_handling: Images inside portfolio mockups must be crisp. Images in the About section should be grayscale/black-and-white to fit the studio aesthetic.

assets.description: Modern wooden chairs. Use for the 'Alpaca Furniture Revitalization' case study mockup.
Red lawn mower cutting grass. Use for the 'Stripes Lawn Care' case study mockup.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and setup Lenis (`@studio-freight/lenis`) for smooth scrolling. Wrap the app in a Lenis provider.
Install `framer-motion` for the kinetic hero, scroll reveals, and micro-interactions.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the marketing layouts to maintain absolute control over the grid and overlaps. Avoid generic UI cards.

For the contact form, use Shadcn components (Form, Input, Textarea, Select, Button) but heavily customize them via Tailwind to match the dark studio theme (e.g., bg-transparent, border-b only, focus:ring-accent).
Ensure `data-testid` is added to all interactive elements, nav links, form inputs, and buttons.
Never use pure black (#000000). Always use the defined charcoal (#0D0D0F).
Never use transparent headers over content without a backdrop-blur. The sticky nav must have a distinct glassmorphism or solid surface.
In the kinetic hero, split the H1 into an array of words/lines, wrap each in an overflow-hidden span, and use framer-motion to translate Y from 100% to 0%.
Mix the Cabinet Grotesk font with Cormorant Garamond italicized for words like 'Stand Out' in the hero headline.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially the #8B8B93 muted text, meets WCAG AA standards against the #0D0D0F background.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion via Framer Motion's useReducedMotion hook. If true, swap translateY animations for simple opacity fades.
accessibility.focus: All focus states must be visible. Use focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#D45B3E] focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-[#0D0D0F].

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use negative space aggressively to separate components.
Never center align the App container in CSS. All text must respect natural reading flow.
Do not apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`.
Include a `data-testid` attribute on all interactive elements to support automated testing.
Never use placeholders for logos or text; use actual styling and provided images.
Use `sonner` for any toast notifications needed in forms.
